method: Local OCR, no model API or network calls.

thread_policy: Three concurrent page jobs; OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 per Tesseract process.

qa_status: Complete: all 54 source pages accounted for; 52 text-bearing pages recovered; 2 source-blank pages visually confirmed.
confidence_note: Tesseract word confidence is a diagnostic, not a calibrated accuracy estimate.
selection_reason: PSM6 preserves the single-column paragraph-number order and paired cover-table values; selected after source-image review, not solely from confidence.
source_image_review: Every source page inspected in labelled contact sheets; first/middle/last pages, both blanks and all pages with character-weighted word confidence below93 additionally reviewed at readable resolution.
content_policy: Raw selected OCR only, with form-feed page separators. No legal rewriting, inferred words, editorial page headers, reconstruction of redacted names, or annotations inside the OCR text.
observed_limitations: OCR artefacts remain in logos, underlined headings, paragraph labels, punctuation and some names.
Handwritten signatures and redacted regions are not reliable OCR evidence and were not reconstructed.
Page-level checks establish recovered content and order, not a certified word-perfect legal transcription.

commands.ocr_text_pages: OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 tesseract IMAGE OUTPUT -l eng --oem 1 --psm 6 --dpi 300 txt tsv
commands.diagnostic_and_blank_pages: OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 tesseract IMAGE OUTPUT -l eng --oem 1 --psm 3 --dpi 300 txt tsv

output_sha256_policy: checksums.sha256 covers every delivered OCR/QA file except the checksum listing itself.
note_other_failed_sources: The failed EUR-Lex Opinion representations for C-380/22 P and C-499/24 P have existing complete local Curia TXT alternatives linked to the same source events; they are not additional document-content gaps.
human_review_scope: Page accounting, orientation, visible text presence, reading order and OCR coverage; no human legal interpretation or rewriting.
